name: Image & Camera
description: Displays an image from a URL (fetched via server), a live MJPEG stream, or a random image from a server folder.
author: Tilewright

addonSettingsSchema.label: Optional Auth Header Value
addonSettingsSchema.helpText: Write-only secret sent by the server when fetching URLs.

addonSettingsSchema.label: Local Image Folder Root
addonSettingsSchema.helpText: Optional override folder for random local images (defaults to data/addons/image/images).

tiles.name: Image / Camera
tiles.description: Server-fetched URL image, live MJPEG stream, or random folder photo.

settingsSchema.label: Image / Stream URL
settingsSchema.helpText: Used when Source is Remote URL or MJPEG stream.

settingsSchema.label: Subfolder (optional)
settingsSchema.helpText: Relative subfolder under the image folder root.

settingsSchema.label: Refresh interval
settingsSchema.helpText: e.g. 5s for camera snapshot, 2h for photo frame. Disabled for MJPEG streams.
